response.justification: While Bogdan is a highly experienced Staff Software Engineer with strong architectural and event-driven systems background, his recent experience is entirely focused on TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang. The role strictly requires deep expertise in C++, STL, and industrial cybersecurity standards (IEC 62443), which are either missing or very dated (7 months in 2014-2015) in his profile.
strengths: Over 15 years of software engineering experience, including Staff-level and architectural roles.
Strong background in event-driven architectures, microservices, and advantageous technologies like Node.js and React.
Demonstrated commitment to software craftsmanship, TDD, CI/CD, and team mentoring.
concerns: Critically lacks recent or extensive C++ and STL experience, having only 7 months of professional exposure in 2014-2015.
No demonstrated experience with industrial automation environments, IoT MQTT, or protocols like Modbus and OPC UA.
Missing required expertise in Secure Development Lifecycle (SDL) practices and IEC 62443 cybersecurity standards.
